source.title: Blizzard official Armory: Kickinstuff equipped Miststalker's Wristbands at item level 305
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

notes: NEW VERIFIED EQUIPPED-ITEM-LEVEL IDENTITY, NOT A DISENCHANT OPERATION. Indexed live Blizzard Armory character gear explicitly lists Miststalker's Wristbands with displayed item level 305 on Kickinstuff (US Stormrage). Independently indexed Blizzard Armory Chaiashka (US Sargeras) also displays the named item at 305 (https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/worldsoul/us/armory/character/sargeras/chaiashka/); Mistyk (EU Burning Legion) displays it at 321 (https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/worldsoul/eu/armory/character/burning-legion/mistyk/). GamGem live Blizzard base-item lookup maps the unique name to item ID 272246, EPIC leather wrist armor, but base record preview is ilvl 206 (https://gamgem.com/world-of-warcraft/items/miststalkers-wristbands). Armory search-index excerpts identify equipped item/name/level, but live pages may block direct fetch; item GUID, full itemLink with bonuses, enhancement, 272246 ID on the exact equipped instance, snapshot collection date and ownership of an actual DE cast are NOT independently exposed in excerpts. This verifies actual equipped level 305 exists, NOT a successful or eligible disenchant, material type, sample denominator, drop rate, skill/spec or build. WoWDB base-item 'Cannot be disenchanted' conflict remains; do not infer eligibility or empirical material yield, or import as a measured cohort.
